theme_strategy.vibe: High-end Paris newsroom press, authoritative financial actuarial editorial platform

typography.font_pairing_strategy: Editorial Press Serif (Headings) + Clean Swiss Sans (Body) + Precision Tech Mono (Data/Badges)
rules: Headings (H1/H2) must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) with bold editorial serif weights.
Main H1 scale ceiling: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-5xl (never exceed text-6xl).
Overlines and tags must be uppercase, tiny (text-xs), and tracking-[0.2em].
Do NOT use Inter for main headings; preserve the financial press journal character.

spacing_and_layout.containers: Generous internal padding (p-6 to p-8) with crisp 1px borders.
spacing_and_layout.stepper: 6-step editorial workflow indicator (Source -> Analyse -> Score -> Angle -> Caption -> Visual).

grid_modes.mode_selection: 2-column bento hero grid with distinct primary actions for pasted URL vs broad topic research.
grid_modes.results_page: 2-column grid (Left: Editorial Score + Analysis + Editable Caption | Right: Interactive 4:5 LinkedIn Visual Preview & Controls).

forsides_visual_identity_rules.top_banner: Large bold 'NEWS' wordmark with a dark-red rectangle (#991B1B) behind the word 'NEWS'.
forsides_visual_identity_rules.visual_aspect_ratio: 1200x1500 (4:5 aspect ratio) tailored for LinkedIn feeds.

versions.version_a: Editorial News with IA illustration background & dark-red news banner
versions.version_b: Data & Insight Infographic canvas with high-impact key numbers and structured bullet points

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, input fields, badges, score gauges, caption area, export buttons, and visual edit controls MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: High contrast text over dark red banners (pure white text with slight drop shadow when over images).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application strictly follows the 6-step editorial workflow.
Mode 1 must scrape/extract source, date, topic, sector, key figures, regulatory changes, and consequences.
Mode 2 must simulate research across 15-30 French actuarial/insurance sources (EIOPA, ACPR, DREES, France Assureurs, Solvabilité II, IFRS 17) and support 'Refresh selection'.
Editorial score panel must calculate scores out of 100 with the 7 weighted criteria and classification bands.
Caption editor must offer Court, Standard, Analytique, and Décryptage approfondi modes with quick action buttons.
Canvas rendering for LinkedIn 4:5 visual must render natively on client side HTML5 canvas / SVG export to high-res PNG.
Include automatic Content Quality Score /100 with improvement suggestions if <75.
Export functionalities: Copy caption, Download PNG visual, Export full package.
